acceptanceCriteria.description: Slice 1 moved canonical Orders list/detail composition into a read-only backend read-model owner while preserving byte-identical Awaiting and Shipped table snapshots.

Slice 2 moved override, dimension-coherence, Apply Best Rate, and saved Best Rate persistence into the command owner, which delegates to existing rate, package, and transaction-time editability authorities.
Boundary tests exist at both extracted owners, the route keeps smoke/delegation guards, and the mandatory source-of-truth pack includes the PL-3 boundary guard.

LOCKED_STATUSES and assertOrderEditable remain in the Orders route unmodified by the extraction, every relevant mutation guards before delegation, and transaction-time lifecycle predicates remain fail-closed.
The card-mandated PS-173, PS-387, PS-329, byte-identical DOM snapshots, strict TypeScript, production build, rate-source, API-contract, and full source-of-truth gates pass at the reviewed SHA.

canonicalOwners: src/services/orders-read-model.ts owns canonical Orders list/detail DTO composition and remains read-only
src/services/orders-overrides-command.ts owns override, box/dimension coherence, Apply Best Rate, and saved Best Rate persistence
src/services/shipping-workflow/apply-best-rate.ts and the existing rate proof/eligibility owners retain authoritative rate decisions
src/services/order-editable-write.ts retains the transaction-time lifecycle predicate while src/routes/orders.ts retains the early LOCKED_STATUSES and assertOrderEditable boundary

oldOwners.path: src/routes/orders.ts inline override and Best Rate command persistence

wrappers.delegatesTo: the read-model and command owners after auth, scope, validation, and assertOrderEditable

sotBypass.details: The route no longer owns canonical DTO or override/rate persistence logic. It retains transport, scope, and edit-lock enforcement and delegates to the named backend owners; frontend consumers render backend DTOs without minting rate or lifecycle truth.

evidence.proves: Both dedicated owners exist, the read owner performs no persistence, command persistence lives in the command owner, route-local duplicate owners are absent, the route remains below the line-count ratchet, and all extracted mutations guard before delegation.
All three mocked browser cases pass, including byte-identical Awaiting and Shipped table DOM plus the large-page virtualization check, with no live API/provider request.

evidence.proves: Effective lifecycle, canonical row workflow, legacy identity, recipient evidence, package/display facts, and thin frontend consumption retain their established behavior through the extracted read-model owner.

evidence.proves: The extracted command composes backend snapshot finalization, proof, fingerprint, eligibility, house-tuple, DTO validation, and one atomic override persist while the route guards and delegates.

evidence.proves: Backend rate authorization rejects cross-order, cross-account, shipment-fact, and source-identity drift before the provider spy; one valid backend-issued proof reaches the spy exactly once.

evidence.proves: The early route guard and final row-locked transaction owner reject terminal lifecycle races; 25 deterministic edit-versus-shipping races pass without a losing write.

evidence.proves: All 53 mandatory backend-truth, rate, lifecycle, durable-worker, auth/scope, billing, inventory, migration-readiness, and governance commands pass; the first environment-free attempt stopped only at import validation and the inert rerun passed completely.

evidence.command: npm run typecheck && npm run build:web && npm run test:api-contracts && npm run test:rate-source-of-truth
evidence.proves: Strict backend/frontend TypeScript, production frontend compilation of 2,979 modules, API contracts, and rate source-of-truth placement all pass at the reviewed SHA.

The pure extraction commit predates the Trello card, includes the required override annotation and commit message, is contained by reviewed stable, and removed route-local ownership without modifying the locked helper definitions.

verification.command: not applicable - PS-454 is an existing pure service extraction and this closure adds documentation only

migrations.rollbackPlan: No schema rollback is required. This closure adds documentation only. A future rollback of the historical extraction would require a separately reviewed locked-surface change and must preserve terminal edit locks, rate proof, and shipped/cancelled history.

rollback.strategy: No runtime rollback is required for this closure. If the historical extraction regresses, roll forward in the canonical service owners; do not restore route-local business truth or weaken LOCKED_STATUSES, assertOrderEditable, transaction-time lifecycle predicates, or selected-rate proof.

liveVerification.reason: The historical PS-454 implementation is already contained in the live runtime on all three Render services and the Ready Vercel production deployment. Reviewed stable adds only the PS-453 packet after that runtime SHA. Read-only health checks returned 200 for health and readiness; no redeploy or live business action was needed.

caveats.description: The aggregate deep endpoint remains HTTP 503 from the pre-existing sync-freshness condition recorded during PS-453. API health/readiness and all three runtime deployments are healthy; PS-454 introduces no runtime change.
